svg.title: Gaurav. Software engineer, Flutter developer.
svg.desc: Animated mission-control console. A boot log comes online for callsign Gaurav: station CampusLink active, frontend crew of one, cleared to ship. An orbital view tracks CampusLink and three launched missions: a Unix shell, a multi-agent research assistant and an AI fitness coach. A telemetry ticker lists the payload: Flutter, Dart, BLoC, C++, Python.
